## Overview

Clear active beams when every beam in an offline batch has finished its structured-output grammar. This prevents finalization from adding the same completed sequences a second time and displacing the next-best distinct beam.

## Claims

- Grammar-terminal beams enter the completed set once when structured beam search exits early.
- The regression covers one/two prompts, both EOS settings, and token limits before/after grammar termination; the existing abort regressions remain passing.

## Validation

Candidate `7bf3e961e14dcbe99a7ba0c3386824eab0b2386b` on macOS arm64 / Python 3.12.12. The two changed files still match the validated hashes; no tests were rerun when opening this PR or marking it ready for review:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q --confcutdir=tests/samplers \
  tests/samplers/test_beam_search.py \
  -k 'does_not_duplicate_terminal_beams or abort_returns_partial_outputs'
```

**21 passed, 4 deselected.** These tests use the real tokenizer and xgrammar 0.2.8, with deterministic engine outputs; they do not run a model. The isolated selection excludes the model fixtures in the root conftest.

Using the exact baseline `_beam_search_step` from `a3e0243b1c3ea313b902a43b0f6559fb4148ff81` with the same tests gives **4 expected failures, 17 passes**. The failures return the same best beam twice for `ignore_eos=True`, `max_tokens=3/4`, and one/two prompts. The candidate passes these cases. No baseline source was edited.

Ruff 0.14.0 lint/format, the complete changed-file pre-commit run, and configured mypy checks targeting Python 3.10–3.13 pass after annotating the test inputs as `list[TokensInput]`.

Built the native Apple Silicon CPU runtime with the pinned PyTorch 2.13.0 dependencies; the same 21 focused regressions pass. Real `LLM.beam_search` with SmolLM2-135M (revision `93efa2f097d58c2a74874c7e644dbc9b0cee75a2`), FP32 and xgrammar covers eight cases: two prompts (`Choose one letter:` / `Answer briefly:`), `ignore_eos=False/True`, `max_tokens=6/8`, beam width 2 and regex `a|b`. The exact base Python method in the same native runtime duplicates a sequence in four cases; the candidate returns no duplicates in all eight and matches the deduplicated baseline outputs. Model and engine outputs are real. The baseline native package was not separately rebuilt; GPU, other models and the complete serving suite were not tested.

**The submitting human has confirmed reviewing this revision and personally running the relevant tests. The detailed local validation above was performed with AI assistance.**

## Details

The structured-output path already appends grammar-terminal beams to `instance.completed`. When all beams terminate, it returns before replacing `instance.beams`; finalization then extends `completed` with those retained beams. Clearing those exhausted active lists before returning preserves the completed results and prevents duplication. Unstructured, partially active, and abort paths are unchanged.

This is a follow-up to structured beam search in [#35022](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/35022). Searches of structured/duplicate/terminal beam PRs and diffs of the nearby open [online structured-output PR #36285](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/36285), [stop-string PR #52621](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52621), and [detokenization test PR #49541](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49541) did not identify this same early-exit fix. These nearby changes are potential integration context, not issues this patch claims to resolve.

On 2026-10-07, all eight open beam-search PRs were checked, including allowed-token IDs [#47630](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/47630) and length-penalty [#59506](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59506). None contains this early-exit fix. The affected method in upstream main `db6e3cd8c4f9b84c39fe3c44fab0b1d3117f758b` still matches the buggy baseline, and the branch merges cleanly with current main.

AI assistance was used to develop and validate this change. All three commits contain DCO sign-offs. DCO and agent-run validation do not substitute for the required human review and personal testing.

---

@@ -11,7 +11,9 @@
 
 import jsonschema
 import pytest
-from transformers import AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM
+from tokenizers import Tokenizer
+from tokenizers.models import WordLevel
+from transformers import AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM, TokenizersBackend
 
 from vllm import CompletionOutput, RequestOutput
 from vllm.assets.audio import AudioAsset
@@ -50,6 +52,87 @@
 MODELS = ["TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0"]
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ignore_eos", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_tokens", [2, 3, 4])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_prompts", [1, 2])
+def test_structured_beam_search_does_not_duplicate_terminal_beams(
+    monkeypatch, ignore_eos: bool, max_tokens: int, num_prompts: int
+) -> None:
+    """Grammar termination must not displace the second-best distinct beam."""
+    tokenizer = TokenizersBackend(
+        tokenizer_object=Tokenizer(
+            WordLevel(
+                {"<eos>": 0, "a": 1, "b": 2, "prompt": 3, "<unk>": 4},
+                unk_token="<unk>",
+            )
+        ),
+        eos_token="<eos>",
+        unk_token="<unk>",
+    )
+    llm = LLM.__new__(LLM)
+    llm.model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        get_vocab_size=lambda: 5, hf_config=SimpleNamespace(model_type="unit_test")
+    )
+    llm.llm_engine = Mock(
+        vllm_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            model_config=llm.model_config,
+            speculative_config=None,
+            structured_outputs_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                backend="xgrammar", disable_any_whitespace=False
+            ),
+        )
+    )
+    llm.renderer = Mock(get_tokenizer=Mock(return_value=tokenizer))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_preprocess_cmpl", lambda prompts: prompts)
+
+    def run_requests(prompts, **kwargs):
+        results = []
+        for prompt in prompts:
+            tokens = prompt["prompt_token_ids"]
+            logprobs = (
+                {1: Logprob(-0.7), 2: Logprob(-1.0)}
+                if len(tokens) == 1
+                else {0: Logprob(-0.1)}
+            )
+            results.append(
+                RequestOutput(
+                    request_id="inner",
+                    prompt=None,
+                    prompt_token_ids=tokens,
+                    prompt_logprobs=None,
+                    finished=True,
+                    outputs=[
+                        CompletionOutput(
+                            index=0,
+                            text="",
+                            token_ids=[next(iter(logprobs))],
+                            cumulative_logprob=None,
+                            logprobs=[logprobs],
+                            finish_reason="length",
+                        )
+                    ],
+                )
+            )
+        return results
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_render_and_run_requests", run_requests)
+    prompts: list[TokensInput] = [
+        {"type": "token", "prompt_token_ids": [3]} for _ in range(num_prompts)
+    ]
+    outputs = llm.beam_search(
+        prompts,
+        BeamSearchParams(
+            beam_width=2,
+            max_tokens=max_tokens,
+            ignore_eos=ignore_eos,
+            structured_outputs=StructuredOutputsParams(regex="a|b"),
+        ),
+    )
+    assert len(outputs) == num_prompts
+    for output in outputs:
+        assert [beam.tokens for beam in output.sequences] == [[3, 1, 0], [3, 2, 0]]
+
+
 @pytest.mark.parametrize(("abort_after", "prompt_token"), [(0, 1), (1, 1), (0, 0)])
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("terminal_logprobs", [None, [], [{11: Logprob(-0.1)}]])
 def test_beam_search_abort_returns_partial_outputs_and_continues_other_prompts(
